title: Saved in another tab
text: This was saved in another tab or device after you opened it. Nothing is overwritten until you choose.
deleted_text: This was deleted in another tab or device. Your edits are still here.
load_failed: The saved version couldn't be loaded.

option_help.save_as_new: Creates a copy with your edits, the original keeps the other version.
option_help.overwrite: Replaces the other version with yours.
option_help.reload: Drops your edits and loads the saved version.

deleted_option_help.save_as_new: Creates a new plan with your edits.

notice.saved_elsewhere: Saved in another tab. Your edits are kept.
notice.session_replaced: You logged in in another tab. Reload this tab to continue; it no longer saves anything.
notice.db_blocked: PRUNplanner is open in another tab with an older version. Close the other tabs or reload them to continue.
